description: LiveCA’s form asks which accounting services the visitor wants and which system they use. The completed assessment found no published supplier route, so hold that inquiry and revisit it if LiveCA publishes one. The Canadian Dext page returned HTTP 200, giving the existing invoice QA mission a source to check for a concrete export workflow and a distinct use for the tested subtotal check. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
